description: Vendored XML Schemas for offline CAP 1.2 validation. CAP-v1.2.xsd does not import xmldsig; it declares <any namespace="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#" processContents="lax"/>, so validation works without the xmldsig schema. The xmldsig schema is vendored so a local lxml resolver can validate ds:Signature strictly if a future stage signs alerts.
